```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
set.seed(42)
```

## For loop to calculate cube of numbers up to 20
```{r}
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  cube <- i^3
  print (cube)
}
```

## Generating 5 random 5 letter strings
```{r}
for (i in seq_len(5)) {
  random_string <- paste(sample(letters, 5, replace = TRUE), collapse="")
  print (random_string)
}
```

## Building a 10-course breakfast
```{r}
breakfast <- c("eggs", "bacon", "sausages", "toast")
breakfast_df <- tibble()
for (i in seq_len(10)) {
  item <- sample(breakfast, size = 1)
  count <- sample(1:5, 1)
  current_row <- tibble (
    item = item,
    count = count
  )
  breakfast_df <- breakfast_df |> bind_rows(current_row)
}
gt(breakfast_df)
```
